title: Fish import notification
description: A notification of fish or fish products to be imported into Great Britain. This schema describes the stored notification in any state, from a draft saved during the journey to a submitted notification. Only identity and state are required, so that an incomplete draft is valid. The stricter rules that apply at submission are in fis-notification-submitted.schema.json. Dates and times follow ISO 8601. Countries use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

id.description: Identifier of the notification record. It is the UUID generated by the front end for the draft, and it is also the idempotency key for creating the draft.

reference.description: Unique reference of the notification, in the form GBN-FIS-YY-XXXXX. It is allocated when the draft is first saved and does not change.

organisationId.description: Identifier of the organisation that owns the notification. When an agent creates the notification, this is the agent's organisation.

importerOrganisationId.description: Identifier of the importer's organisation. Set when an agent creates the notification on behalf of an importer.

createdBy.description: The user who created the notification, and the role they acted in.

userId.description: Identifier of the user who created the notification.

actingAs.description: Role of the user when creating the notification. IMPORTER: the user acts for their own organisation as the importer. AGENT: the user acts on behalf of an importer.

concurrencyToken.description: Version counter used to prevent one update overwriting another. It starts at 0 and increases by 1 on every successful change.

status.description: State of the notification. DRAFT: being completed by the importer or agent and not yet visible to the port health authority. SUBMITTED: formally submitted for review. DELETED: removed by the user and no longer active.

createdAt.description: Date and time the notification was first saved, in UTC.

updatedAt.description: Date and time the notification was last changed, in UTC.

submittedAt.description: Date and time the notification was submitted, in UTC. Present only once submitted.

receivedAt.description: Date and time the service received the submission, in UTC. Normally the same as submittedAt.

fieldProvenance.description: Records where a value came from when it was read from a document, calculated, or changed after it was first captured. Values typed in by the user have no entry.

Notification.description: The content of the notification: how the consignment travels, when and where it arrives, what it contains, who is involved and which documents support it.

landingType.description: How the fish arrive. CONTAINERISED: delivered in containers. DIRECT_LANDING: landed directly from the fishing vessel. OTHER: any other arrangement.

countryOfExport.description: Country the consignment is exported from, in the two-letter upper-case format used by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. The prototype checks the format but does not check membership against country reference data.

exportRegion.description: Whether the country of export is in the EU-27. EU: a member state of the EU-27. REST_OF_WORLD: any other country. It is calculated from countryOfExport and determines whether a CHED reference is needed. The SPS agreement exemption is deferred until country reference data is provided by MDM.

commodities.description: The goods in the consignment, one entry per commodity code.

agent.description: The agent acting for the importer, where one is used.

responsibleParty.description: Who is responsible for the notification. IMPORTER: the importer. AGENT: the agent acting for the importer.

documents.description: Documents that support the notification. Each entry refers to a stored file. The file itself is not held here.

Transport.description: How the consignment travels to Great Britain. Only the mode is entered by the user. The other details are normally read from the supporting documents.

mode.description: Means of transport on arrival. VESSEL: ship or other vessel. AIR_FREIGHT: aircraft. ROAD_VEHICLE: lorry or other road vehicle.

vesselName.description: Name of the vessel carrying the consignment.

imoNumber.description: International Maritime Organization number of the vessel.

vehicleRegistration.description: Registration number of the vehicle, for road transport.

containerNumbers.description: Identification numbers of the containers carrying the consignment.

transportDocumentReference.description: Reference of the transport document, such as a bill of lading or air waybill.

Arrival.description: When and where the consignment is expected to arrive in Great Britain.

portOfEntry.description: Code of the port or airport where the consignment arrives, from the reference data list of ports.

borderControlPost.description: Code of the border control post that serves the port of entry, where border control rules apply.

expectedArrivalDate.description: Expected date of arrival, as YYYY-MM-DD. It must be a real date that is not in the past when entered.

expectedArrivalTime.description: Expected time of arrival on the 24-hour clock, as HH:mm.

expectedArrivalAt.description: Expected arrival as a single date and time in UTC. It is calculated from the expected date and time and is used for sorting.

Ched.description: Common Health Entry Document (CHED) details. Required for consignments from outside the EU. Not used for consignments from the EU.

reference.description: CHED-P reference, in the form CHEDP.GB.YYYY.NNNNNNN.

Commodity.description: A commodity in the consignment, identified by its commodity code, with the species it contains.

commodityCode.description: Commodity code (CN code) of the goods.

species.description: The species in this commodity. Only species that belong to the commodity code can be entered.

totalNetWeightKg.description: Total net weight of the commodity in kilograms. It is the sum of the net weights of its species.

totalNetFisheryProductWeightKg.description: Total net fishery product weight of the commodity in kilograms. It is the sum of the species values where they are given.

Species.description: A species of fish within a commodity, with its declared weight.

speciesCode.description: Code of the species from the reference data list.

netWeightKg.description: Net weight of the species in kilograms, as declared by the importer.

netFisheryProductWeightKg.description: Net fishery product weight of the species in kilograms, as declared by the importer.

Party.description: A person or organisation involved in the import. It is a copy of the details at the time they were captured, so later changes to a profile do not alter a submitted notification.

name.description: Name of the company or organisation.

eori.description: Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number.

countryCode.description: Country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

DocumentRef.description: A reference to a document that supports the notification.

documentType.description: Kind of document. CATCH_CERTIFICATE: catch certificate. SIMPLIFIED_CATCH_CERTIFICATE: simplified catch certificate. REEXPORT_CATCH_CERTIFICATE: re-export catch certificate. PROCESSING_STATEMENT: processing statement. NON_MANIPULATION_DECLARATION: non-manipulation declaration. ADDITIONAL: any other supporting document.

documentReference.description: Reference number printed on the document.

reviewStatus.description: Progress of the importer's check of the details read from the document. NOT_STARTED: not yet checked. NEEDS_REVIEW: some details were unclear or missing and must be checked. COMPLETE: checked and confirmed.

Declaration.description: The importer's declaration made when submitting the notification.

optionVersion.description: Identifier of the declaration wording shown to the user.

statements.description: The statements the user was asked to accept.

accepted.description: Whether the user accepted the statement.

acceptedAt.description: Date and time the declaration was accepted, in UTC.

acceptedByUserId.description: Identifier of the user who accepted the declaration.

FieldProvenance.description: Where a value came from and, if it was changed, what it was before.

path.description: Location of the value within the notification content.

source.description: How the value was set. MANUAL: entered by the user. EXTRACTED: read automatically from a document. CORRECTED: read from a document and then changed by the user. AUTHORITY_ENTERED: entered by an authority user. DERIVED: calculated by the service.

documentId.description: Identifier of the document the value was read from.

confidence.description: Confidence of the automatic reading, from 0 (none) to 1 (certain).

originalValue.description: The value as first read from the document. Kept when the value is corrected.

changedAt.description: Date and time the value was last set or changed, in UTC.

changedByUserId.description: Identifier of the user who last set or changed the value.
